description: A chronic implantation fungal infection of the skin and subcutaneous tissue, commonly affecting exposed limbs.
causes: Dematiaceous fungi introduced through minor skin trauma
risk_factors: Exposure to soil, wood, and plant material

appearance.general: A slowly growing verrucous crusted nodule or plaque, often on the foot or hand; satellite lesions may develop.

warning_signs: A longstanding enlarging verrucous lesion or ulceration warrants medical assessment.
doctor_discussion_points: Discuss geographic exposure, trauma, lesion duration, and whether biopsy or fungal culture is needed.
